tasks.title: Conversation #108
tasks.transcript:
Man: Hi, Anna. Do you happen to know whether the library is staying open late tonight? I heard there might be a schedule change due to the maintenance work.
Woman: Actually, yes, it's still open until 10 p.m. on weekdays. Even during the renovations, they've just relocated the study areas to the east wing temporarily.
Man: That's a relief. I've got a big exam tomorrow and I really need a quiet place to focus. My apartment is too noisy lately.
Woman: I get that. Just make sure you pace yourself, take breaks so you don't burn out. Studying nonstop can backfire.

questions.stem: Why is the man planning to go to the library?

options.B: To check on the renovation progress
options.C: To meet with a study group

questions.analysis: 答案：A 题目问的是：男士为什么计划去图书馆？ 定位原文：Man: I've got a big exam tomorrow and I really need a quiet place to focus. My apartment is too noisy lately. 选项分析： A. To avoid distractions at home 为了避开家里的干扰。男士明确说公寓太吵，需要安静的地方集中注意力，所以A选项正确。 B. To check on the renovation progress 去查看翻新的进度。男士只是询问图书馆是否因维修而改变开放时间，并不是为了查看进度，所以B选项错误。 C. To meet with a study group 与学习小组见面。对话中未提及学习小组，所以C选项错误。 D. To return borrowed materials 归还借阅的资料。对话中未提及还书或还资料，所以D选项错误。

questions.stem: What is the woman's advice about studying?

options.B: Start several weeks before an exam.
options.C: Don't try to do too much at once.

questions.analysis: 答案：C 题目问的是：女士关于学习给出了什么建议？ 定位原文：Woman: Just make sure you pace yourself, take breaks so you don't burn out. Studying nonstop can backfire. 选项分析： A. Group study is best. 小组学习最好。对话中未提及小组学习，所以A选项错误。 B. Start several weeks before an exam. 考试前几周就开始学习。对话中未提及提前多久开始学习，所以B选项错误。 C. Don't try to do too much at once. 不要试图一次做太多。女士建议要“pace yourself”（掌握好节奏）并“take breaks”（休息），不要“burn out”（过度疲劳），这正对应不要一次性学太多，所以C选项正确。 D. Study early in the morning. 早上学习。对话中未提及早上学习，所以D选项错误。
